description: Fixed Ohio Open Child Care Center acquisition with fresh source-use prerequisites, internal retained evidence and independently verified local-review normalization. Not a census of businesses or all childcare.

output_schema_contract.verification: scripts/verify-oh-childcare-app.mjs independently verifies a completed app receipt and both exact linked immutable releases. Reprocessing uses a verified in-memory acquisition snapshot without network.
output_schema_contract.postal_fields: Separate nullable ZIP5 and ZIP4. Missing or invalid source ZIPs retain explicit quality reasons; no inference from coordinates.
output_schema_contract.geocode: Business records carry nullable latitude/longitude only. Internal source point geometry is requested in EPSG:4326. County text and broad Ohio bounds are not governed Census assignments.
output_schema_contract.claims: Source Open status and program numbers are unverified assertions, not proof of operation, license validity, unique identity or complete state/industry coverage. All-quarantine evidence is retained rather than mislabeled as a business-quality pass.

redirect_policy: Reject redirects and omit credentials. Fixed Ohio layer, item, count/status, ID/page and four reviewed notice URLs only. No caller endpoint, query, selected-field, source-use, timeout, clock or budget overrides.
retry: Bounded transient/timeout/429/5xx retries, with publisher Retry-After honoured or deferred above one minute. Schema, scope, notice or ownership drift and cancellation stop acquisition. No automatic job restart or freshness reuse.
checkpoint: Persist job identity before collection, source-use prerequisites before IDs/rows, each validated response before the next request, and completed acquisition reference before normalization. Incomplete journals are inspection evidence, not automatic resume authorization.
idempotency: Immutable UUID app/acquisition/normalization runs. Reuse completed acquisition for reprocessing/promotion rather than repulling it. Native acquisition is an explicit new source run, not a freshness deduplicator.
cancellation: Cooperative signals and IPC. Remove owned unpublished acquisition/normalization staging; preserve completed releases and app history. Verify a nonterminal app receipt candidate before atomic success publication. No cancellation inside final commit, stale lock reclamation or automatic crash recovery.
retention_profile: Internal source evidence and local-review-only normalization, with operator-governed deletion. Historical policy and offline release versions remain unchanged.
